title: Bridgeport, CT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bridgeport, CT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bridgeport is a city in CT with a population of 148,654. Connecticut’s largest city with affordable housing by Northeast standards and train to NYC. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.

Last updated: September 12, 2026
